title: Q-ULTRA-country-snapshot-spend-UNMEASURED: essential variable country-snapshot:spend cannot be read
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** `country-snapshot:spend` has no fresh reading (source tenant.spend_vs_budget)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status
**Status:** closed

An unmeasured variable is never in bounds and never a reason to change the system. Make the reading (probe, writer or fresh ledger row) so the loop can judge it.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status` shows `country-snapshot:spend` with a value.


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-20T18:56:44Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 24.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
